pages.text: After the rain, a wide puddle formed in the yard. Mom gave them two sheets of paper.
They wanted to float boats they had folded themselves. "Let us see whose boat reaches the other side first!"
Lolo folded quickly. Riri lined up the corners and pressed firmly. "The first to launch wins." "A neat boat sails well."
Lolo's boat splashed into the puddle, tilting to one side.
Water soaked in, and the boat sank. Lolo lifted out the wet paper.
Riri kept folding and unfolding. The paper filled with creases.
When she finally launched it, her boat just floated in place. No matter how long they waited, it did not move.
Lolo blew gently behind the boat. It slipped forward.
Riri folded one more boat. Lolo blew, puff, puff, behind both boats.
Two paper boats crossed the puddle. Lolo's cheeks puffed out. Riri picked up the boats and put them back on the starting line.
